name: QuantumScape Corporation
business: QuantumScape develops solid-state lithium-metal battery cells for electric vehicle makers, AI data centers and aerospace and defense customers; it is pre-revenue.

events.what: COO of QuantumScape Battery appointed (not CEO or CFO)
Director appointed (ex CFO of Cadence, NVIDIA)
Three business verticals set up (QSEV automotive, QSDC AI data centers, QSAS aerospace and defense) plus Honda partnership
CEO appointed (outside the 18-month window); CFO Kevin Hettrich unchanged
events.from: Western Digital (President, Technology and Strategy); joined QS as President 2023-09-11

next_event.source: doc 103650, Sivaram 2026-07-22: 'We are committed to sharing more on our technology roadmap later this year.' A technology update, not a margin framework. No Investor Day found in Baba.

margin_framing.metric_basis_note: Pre-revenue. Only financial guide is an absolute FY2026 adjusted EBITDA loss of $250M to $275M and capex of $27M to $37M; no margin metric exists to frame.

statements.quote: For full-year 2026, we reiterate our Adjusted EBITDA loss guidance of between $250 million and $275 million.
statements.speaker: Kevin Hettrich

street.gap_assumption: Not applicable: consensus revenue is $0.3M (FY2026), $17.2M (FY2027), $62.6M (FY2028) against EBITDA of -$283M, -$276M, -$248M, so margins are not meaningful. Calendar fiscal year, Baba FY labels equal company years. Note data_comps reports current_fy 2027 for this row; its -16.05 'margin' is FY2027 EBITDA over FY2027 revenue.

evidence_of_progress.note: Pre-revenue; margin not meaningful. Q2 2026 adjusted EBITDA loss $64.2M (doc 103650) vs Q2 2025 -$63.0M (VA). Customer billings $21.8M year to date vs $19.5M for all of 2025. Liquidity $859M. The data_comps 12-month 'revision' of +9.9% is the forward EBITDA LOSS widening from -$251.6M to -$276.5M, not an improvement.

disqualifier_reason: Pre-revenue development-stage company: there is no margin to expand and no margin framing to test, so the archetype does not apply. CEO (2024-02-15) is outside the 18-month window and CFO is unchanged; in-window changes are a COO and board seats only.
verdict: Pre-revenue battery developer with a 75% drawdown; no CEO or CFO change in window and no margin story, so not a GXO-style setup.
open_questions: When does QS report material revenue (consensus FY2028 $62.6M) that would make a margin framework possible?
Does the promised technology roadmap update later in 2026 include any commercial or unit-economics targets?
